question: reporting chain from a TEC engineer up to CEO
response:
Here's the TEC reporting chain from an engineer (IC) up to CEO, based on the directory:

| Level | Role | Name | Unit |
|-------|------|------|------|
| **IC** | Engineer (e.g. Software Engineer) | *(~1,800+ ICs across TEC sections)* | TEC-{section}-* |
| **Lead** | Lead Engineer (e.g. Lead Mobile SE) | อภิชัย กิตติพงศ์ (KUNG) | TEC-MOB-LEAD-9 |
| **Manager** | Manager Engineer (e.g. Manager Mobile SE) | แหวน ใจเขียววัฒน์ | TEC-MOB-MGR-1 |
| **Director** | Director Engineer (e.g. Director Mobile SE) | กานติมา ใจเขียวชัย | TEC-MOB-DR-2 |
| **VP** | VP Technology | ณัฐพงษ์ อธิดี | TECVP |
| **VP** | VP Platform | ราชตะ สัมชาญณรงค์ | TECPM |
| **C-level** | CTO | ฤทธิชัย แก้วใสภิญโญ (PANPAN) | CTO |
| **CEO** | CEO | วชิร จิรบุญ (BERRY) | CEO |

**Typical chain:** IC → Lead → Manager → Director → VP → CTO → CEO

Note: TEC has two VPs (Technology & Platform) who both report to the CTO, who in turn reports to the CEO. The Lead and Manager examples above are from the Mobile (MOB) section; each section (FE, BE, MOB, QA, DATA, DS, SEC, etc.) has its own Lead/Manager/Director.
